targets.title: Girls’ comparative advantage in reading can largely explain the gender gap in math-related fields
targets.outcome_quote:

targets.outcome_reasoning: Both new datasets contradict the central claim that comparative reading advantage explains most of the gender gap. Replicating the preliminary reading advantage is not confirmation of the central title finding. Authors explicitly call their result contradictory to the original main result.

reasoning: Two new-sample conceptual replications of one prior paper; other studies in the comparison table are background and are not targets.
